title: Requests
body:
Hello!

I would like to say a big thank you for the Ripples app—I really like it. I use it actively, it helps me track my habits and motivates me to keep going. Great job 🙌

I would like to offer a few ideas/improvements that I think could make the app even more convenient and intuitive:

1. Annual statistics
It would be great to see not only a visual representation in the annual statistics, but also the total number of times the habit was performed during the year — that is, how many times the action was performed during that period.

2. Annual grid of 365 cells
Currently, the app has a grid (112 cells), and it looks very clear. It would be great to also add an annual grid of 365 cells so that you can see the whole year at once — similar to the current view, but in an annual format.

I would be very happy if you would consider these suggestions and perhaps add them in future updates.  
I really like the app and plan to purchase a subscription.

Thank you for your work and for such a great app!
